Author: Virender Singh
Bench: Virender Singh
Harish @ Sonu vs. State of H.P. .
Cr. Revision No.363 of 2025 10.07.2025 Present: Mr. Harsh, Advocate, vice Mr. Manoj Pathak,
Advocate, for the petitioner.

Mr. Anup Rattan, Advocate General with Mr. Mohinder Zharaick, Mr. H.S. Rawat, Additional
Advocates General & Mr. Rohit Sharma, Deputy Advocate General, for the respondent/State.
 r to
 Service is complete.

Certain arguable points are involved in the present petition, as such, the same is admitted for
hearing.

Cr.MP No.2826 of 2025 Petitioner has filed the accompanying revision petition against the judgment dated 17.06.2025, passed by the Court of learned Sessions Judge (Forests), District Shimla, H.P. (hereinafter referred to as 'the Appellate Court'), in Criminal Appeal No.239 of 2022,
titled as Harish @ Sonu versus State of H.P. Vide judgment dated 17.06.2025, the learned Appellate Court has dismissed the appeal filed by the petitioner, against the judgment of conviction and order of sentence, dated 28.05.2022, passed by the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate First Class,
Chopal, District Shimla, H.P., (hereinafter referred to as 'the trial Court'), in Criminal Case No.37-II/2018, titled as State of H.P. versus Harish @ Sonu.
Vide judgment of conviction and order of .
sentence, dated 28.05.2022, the learned trial Court, has convicted the petitioner for the offence punishable under Section 420 of IPC and sentenced him to undergo simple imprisonment, for a period of two years and to pay a fine of Rs.2,000/-.
